title: Memory-only DMM change: the movie raw write buffer (memory id 0x43e) grows from 4288 x 2408 to the A7S III's 26,214,400 bytes, room for the 2848-row full-height first stage
artifact: coprocessor RAM (the DMM server's copy of /cp/DmmCfg.bin); no file is changed

why.camera: first test of ogsq_zv_v1 (2026-11-23): restart on entering movie mode; kept kprint: CAM_VD_SEQUENCE data abort at 0x4b2d86, the deliberate write to 0 after 'FW: S-Ele Refresh ng force exception' (Dev busy at its sync point for 11 frames)
why.code: raw port set-up 0x2613a8 refuses a frame larger than its unit (0x261472: 'CamCore: AIF%d out[0x%x] > memsize[0x%x]'), required = ((step + 1) * (rows - 1) + 1) * pitch

precondition: no unit object of key 0x57f exists in a division still in force when the word is written (the helper checks the DMM server's unit objects and writes nothing otherwise): with the camera on stills after a cold boot, no movie buffer is open
restore: write the old word back under the same condition, or cold boot (the tables are rebuilt from /cp/DmmCfg.bin)

checked_in_the_firmware_allocator.tool: build/emu_dmm_server.py --build zve1_202 (the ZV-E1's own DMM server code, alone; see its header for what is made up)

applied_before_any_open.open_beyond_the_limit: no group offers the key now (0xfeff)

not_shown: that the image hardware takes the full-height stage once the buffer is large enough (the A7S III does, with this size)
what the camera has open when the word is written (the helper checks it and writes nothing if a movie buffer exists)

sites.what: size of the key 0x57f record of group 0x89 (memory id 0x43e, the movie raw write buffer)
